exposure: Training in comprehensive emergency obstetric and neonatal care and anesthesia
outcome: Maternal death from complications of caesarean section
cohort: The study involved 42 associate clinicians from five health centers trained in emergency obstetric and neonatal care, observing 2,179 caesarean sections in intervention centers and 969 in control centers.
finding: Catchment population-based caesarean section rates increased significantly in all five intervention health centers, exceeding 10% in three facilities, with a risk of maternal death from complications of caesarean section in intervention centers being 2.3 per 1,000 caesarean sections.
mod_finding: The intervention led to significantly increased caesarean section rates and improved access to and quality of caesarean section services in the intervention health centers.
